text:
sam: Heads-up — p95 east-west latency spike across rack-12 during noon batch window. Dropped throughput and a few retry loops. Anyone else seeing this?
jordan: Seeing it. p95 between gpu-node-* jumped to ~250ms at ~12:07 UTC, sustained ~3m. Dashboards/trace show queuing in the east-west fabric.
maria: Iperf results from node pair (gpu-12a -> gpu-12b): jitter + occasional retransmit bursts. RDMA stats show increasing rnr_naks and rc_retries.
lee: Ran tcpdump briefly on gpu-12b interface. Noticing a series of out-of-order packets and some fragmented IPs. Could be MTU or offload mismatch.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: daemonset "mtu-fix" completed rollout to rack-12 at 11:45 UTC (image: infra/mtu-fix:v2.1) :warning:
devon: That rollout rings a bell — it toggles jumbo frames (8900) via netplan on hosts. If switches are still 1500 that causes fragmentation/reassembly stalls. Checking leaf configs now.
jordan: On hosts, `ethtool -k` differences: some nodes have GSO=on, some off; GRO inconsistent. Kernel RX queue drops climbing on affected nodes.
maria: Quick mitigation — `kubectl rollout undo ds/mtu-fix -n infra` on rack-12, then `systemctl restart network` on the two worst nodes. Replacing with previous network config.
sam: Good. If rollback doesn't clear in 10m, we'll failover heavy batch jobs to south-dedicated pool and drain the bad nodes.
lee: FYI cost hit if we failover — south-pool runs on reserved infra but pushing extra jobs will transiently increase GPU-hour usage on on-demand nodes. Might double costs for some jobs while rebalancing.
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled up south-dedicated-pool by 4 nodes at 12:15 UTC to absorb failover load.
maria: p95 mostly recovered to ~30ms 6m after rollback. No further retransmits observed. Leaving monitoring alert on for 30m.
devon: Root cause likely mixed MTU/offload state during the daemonset change + switch config drift. Action items: (1) add preflight check in DS to verify leaf MTU, (2) gate rollout by rack labels, (3) add an automated rollback on packet-reorder threshold.
sam: +1 on the action items. Please open a short postmortem with timeline and cost estimate for the failover.
maria: Will file a postmortem and include `tcpdump` + `rdma` counters + grafana panels. Posting links in the doc when ready. :white_check_mark:
